cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Secure the Endorsement
cards.instruction: Get a visible endorsement that makes your decision or position harder to challenge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Would you endorse the new rota into this microphone?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I already said it was fine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Quietly. Quietly can't protect me at the staff meeting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Copy everyone who might blame me.
